sanskrit_verse:
परीक्ष्यः पुरुषः पुंस्त्वे निजैरेवाङ्गलक्षणैः।
पुमांश्चेदविकल्पेन स कन्यां लब्धुमर्हति॥
transliteration: parīkṣyaḥ puruṣaḥ puṃstve nijair evāṅgalakṣaṇaiḥ | pumāṃś ced avikalpena sa kanyāṃ labdhum arhati ||
sph_interpretive_translation: A man is to be examined for maleness by his own bodily marks; if he is unambiguously male, then he is entitled to take a woman.
